jobs.title: NLC India GET 2026: 143 Graduate Executive Trainee Posts through GATE 2025
jobs.summary: NLC India Limited (Advt 10/2026) is recruiting 143 Graduate Executive Trainees in Mechanical, Electrical, Civil and Mining through GATE 2025. Apply online from 13 November to 14 December 2026.
lines: Eligibility: B.E./B.Tech in the matching discipline with min 60% (SC/ST 50%) and a GATE 2025 score in the same paper; Mechanical 66, Electrical 44, Civil 23, Mining 10
Final year: degree must be passed by 1 Nov 2026
Age: max 30 (UR/EWS), 33 (OBC-NCL), 35 (SC/ST) as on 1 Nov 2026; PwBD +10 years
Pay: E-2 Rs 50,000-1,60,000 during 1-year training, then E-3 Rs 60,000-1,80,000
Selection: GATE 2025 score (80) + interview (20), document verification, medical

jobs.title: DSSSB JE 2026: 185 Junior Engineer (Electrical) Posts, Advt 06/2026
jobs.summary: DSSSB has notified 185 Junior Engineer (Electrical) posts (post code 809/26) in Delhi Transco, NDMC, MCD, DUSIB and DAMB; 182 are open without experience. Apply online from 12 November to 11 December 2026.
lines: Eligibility: Delhi Transco - degree or diploma in Electrical Engg; NDMC and MCD - degree in Electrical Engg (diploma holders need 2 years' experience); DUSIB - diploma in Electrical Engg
Age: 18-27 years (NDMC 18-32) as on 11 Dec 2026; relaxation SC/ST 5, OBC 3, PwBD 10 years
Pay: Delhi Transco Level 8 (Rs 52,000-1,51,100); NDMC/MCD/DUSIB Level 6 (Rs 35,400-1,12,400)
Fee: Rs 100; no fee for women, SC, ST, PwBD, ex-servicemen
Selection: Tier-I (shortlisting), Tier-II (final merit), e-dossier, document verification
